title: Sophocarpine Alleviates Airway Epithelial Cell Inflammation in Asthma via Modulating the Cytokine- Cytokine Receptor and JAK2/STAT3 Signaling Pathways.
authors: Zhi, Wenbing; Zhang, Hong; Qiao, Ziyao; Jiang, Shengnan; Liang, Zongsuo; Liu, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苦参碱通过JAK2/STAT3通路缓解哮喘炎症，虽涉及STAT3与分子对接，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Asthma is a complex, heterogeneous, and inflammatory disease with an increasing incidence worldwide. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic mechanisms of sophocarpine in asthma systematically. METHODS: A house dust mite (HDM)-induced mouse and cell model was built. The effects and mechanisms of sophocarpine on asthma were evaluated in vivo and in vitro. RESULTS: In the mouse model, sophocarpine treatment reduced airway pathological damage, mucus secretion, levels of interleukin (IL)-4, IL-5, IL-17, immunoglobulin E (IgE), and splenic index, as well as eosinophil accumulation. Network pharmacology studies revealed that sophocarpine may target TLR4, STAT3, and TNF, and regulates the JAK-STAT, and Viral protein interaction with cytokine and cytokine receptor signaling pathway et al. Docking results showed that the binding energy of sophocarpine to major targets varied from -7.55 to -5.22 kcal/mol. Transcriptome analysis identified 436 DEGs, which were enriched in pathways consistent with the network pharmacology, such as the JAK-STAT signaling pathway. We further confirmed that sophocarpine downregulated the mRNA expression levels of CCL5, CCL7, CCL12, CXCL1, CXCL2, CXCL3, CCR2, CXCR2, CXCR3, JAK2, STAT3, and c-MYC, and protein expression of CXCR2, JAK2, STAT3, and c-MYC in the mouse model. Sophocarpine also inhibited HDM-induced BEAS-2B cell viability decrease, cell apoptosis, and ROS overproduction, which was associated with modulation of the cytokine-cytokine receptor and JAK-STAT signaling pathways. Further, similar to sophocarpine, STAT3 inhibitors and siRNA effectively reduced the levels of STAT3, MYC, and CXCR2. CONCLUSION: These results indicate that sophocarpine effectively inhibits HDM-induced airway epithelial cell inflammation through regulating cytokine-cytokine receptor and JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 目的：哮喘是一种复杂、异质性且炎症性的疾病，在全球范围内发病率不断上升。本研究旨在系统探讨苦参碱在哮喘中的治疗机制。方法：构建了屋尘螨（HDM）诱导的小鼠和细胞模型。在体内和体外评估了苦参碱对哮喘的作用及机制。结果：在小鼠模型中，苦参碱治疗减少了气道病理损伤、黏液分泌、白细胞介素（IL）-4、IL-5、IL-17、免疫球蛋白E（IgE）水平及脾脏指数，以及嗜酸性粒细胞积聚。网络药理学研究表明，苦参碱可能靶向TLR4、STAT3和TNF，并调节JAK-STAT及病毒蛋白与细胞因子和细胞因子受体信号通路等。对接结果显示，苦参碱与主要靶点的结合能在-7.55至-5.22 kcal/mol之间变化。转录组分析识别出436个差异表达基因（DEGs），这些基因富集在与网络药理学一致的信号通路中，如JAK-STAT信号通路。我们进一步证实，在小鼠模型中，苦参碱下调了CCL5、CCL7、CCL12、CXCL1、CXCL2、CXCL3、CCR2、CXCR2、CXCR3、JAK2、STAT3和c-MYC的mRNA表达水平，以及CXCR2、JAK2、STAT3和c-MYC的蛋白表达。苦参碱还抑制了HDM诱导的BEAS-2B细胞活力下降、细胞凋亡和活性氧（ROS）过度产生，这与细胞因子-细胞因子受体和JAK-STAT信号通路的调节相关。此外，与苦参碱类似，STAT3抑制剂和siRNA有效降低了STAT3、MYC和CXCR2的水平。结论：这些结果表明，苦参碱通过调节细胞因子-细胞因子受体和JAK2/STAT3信号通路，有效抑制HDM诱导的气道上皮细胞炎症。
